verdict.rationale: OpenHands is an AI agent product: users type natural-language tasks in the CLI, web GUI or terminal UI and the built-in agent carries them out, with pause and resume, auto-approve and goal-tracking controls. Delegation also extends to Slack @mentions and automated workflows such as CI fixes, PR reviews and security remediation. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of delegation quality, since all evidence is first-party docs or GitHub.
